Layered harmonic drive. GD-XIII provides multi-stage overdrive with complex gain architecture. Multiple stages create layered harmonics beyond what simple clipping achieves. Complex staging builds harmonics progressively. Each stage adds coloration that subsequent stages develop further. The layered approach produces depth and richness. Gain, tone, and level shape the complex drive. Japanese boutique construction ensures quality. True bypass switching. Multi-stage complex overdrive. Demo Videos Specifications Power 9V DC Current Draw ~50mA est.
